Also checksums and chain-of-custody for Snowball artifacts. cc @maria @tim

maria: We can produce a package: CloudTrail (management+data), KMS CloudTrail slice, k8s audit snapshot (etcd/audit), GitHub PR->commit mapping, Snowball job manifest. We'll keep ARNs and hashes intact, redact emails.

tim: I'll run exports for window 2025-11-12T00:00:00Z -> 2025-11-12T06:00:00Z. Queries: CloudTrail for GenerateDataKey/Decrypt/Import; k8s audit for rolebinding create/patch.

raj: The deploy happened ~00:45 via service-account:ci-deploy-bot. I have the CI logs showing `kubectl apply -f rolebinding.yml`. I'll attach PR link and commit hash.
